control.authorization: decoded PRIVATE_APP, local API or INTERNAL, from=0, getFrom=self, to=self, not MQTT, want_ack=false, pki_encrypted=false
control.enable: local prepared exact-config control; accepted only before START and arms the next START; RESET clears the opt-in
control.snapshot: local frozen exact-config control; accepted only after STOP or duration completion with no pending TX

reply.identity: local self PRIVATE_APP reply; request_id matches the control packet ID; header run/source/destination match request config
reply.response_match: raw MeshPacket must have portnum=PRIVATE_APP, transport_mechanism=TRANSPORT_INTERNAL (0) or TRANSPORT_API (7), want_ack=false, pki_encrypted=false, and via_mqtt=false

validity.snapshot: prepared + complete + available or inactive + !running + !active + pending_tx_count=0
validity.active: prepared + complete + available + !running + !active + pending_tx_count=0 + source_kind=1 + overflow=false + transfer_count>0 + transferred_bytes>0
validity.inactive: prepared + complete + !available + !running + !active + pending_tx_count=0 with all metrics and overflow zero
validity.duration: empty count requires sum=max=0; otherwise max<=sum<=count*max unless overflow; UINT64_MAX sum requires overflow

interpretation.window: each board's accepted START handler through that board's STOP return and final owned pending-terminal callback; the receiver includes the armed interval before the sender START; finishRun abort work before freeze included; final post-terminal RadioTxHooks.packetReleased, radio packet-pool release, and final RX rearm excluded
interpretation.window_scope: HAL work during the window includes background control activity and is not limited to payload-only work
interpretation.persistence: local self control only; no RF, MQTT, PKI, or persistent configuration write
interpretation.provenance: collector hashes this protocol, benchmark source, shared radio_gaps source, and executed SDK modules
interpretation.source_policy: canonical active SPI-yield runs require both board source revisions to match; HAL-disabled or otherwise unbound artifacts are rejected
